# facet subject

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:facetSubject`](gmeow-facetSubject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/facetSubject>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)

The person an identity facet (gender identity, gender expression, sexual/romantic orientation) is about — the [`observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) of the claim. Domain is [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) so it applies to any observation subclass; the shape narrows to [`IdentityFacet`](../classes/gmeow-IdentityFacet.md) instances.
